name: Comic Con India (Kolkata)
blurb: Kolkata leg of Comic Con India's national pop-culture tour, run with ReedPop, with comics-industry and pop-culture guests.
notes: Re-checked comicconindia.com fresh (--fresh); the live homepage city slider still only shows Visakhapatnam, Navi Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad and Jalandhar, confirming no 2026-27 Kolkata edition has been announced yet. Added 'last': itvoice.in and thebengal.in ('Comic Con strengthens its footprint in Kolkata: set to return in April 2026') both confirm the most recent Kolkata edition ran April 11-12, 2026 at Biswa Bangla Exhibition Centre - already over before the research window (2026-10-05) opened.
